scope: Public dataframe-form token replay diagnostics; evidence checkpoint, not native parity.

reference_provenance.signature: (log: Union[pm4py.objects.log.obj.EventLog, pandas.DataFrame], petri_net: pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj.PetriNet, initial_marking: pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj.Marking, final_marking: pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj.Marking, activity_key: str = 'concept:name', timestamp_key: str = 'time:timestamp', case_id_key: str = 'case:concept:name', return_diagnostics_dataframe: bool = False, opt_parameters: Optional[Dict[Any, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
reference_provenance.method: opaque module bytes, CRLF normalized to LF, no source decoding

observations: Rows retain exact case groups in first-occurrence order, unlike numeric group-index inference in the public list-output path.
Output case dtype is inferred from first representatives; inference can round distinct case values without merging their rows.
Diagnostic columns are case_id, is_fit, trace_fitness, missing, remaining, produced, consumed.
Valid typed empty input returns a zero-column dataframe.
Output has a fresh RangeIndex and empty attrs; input remains unchanged.
implementation_requirements: Add a native dataframe diagnostic output entry point with shared public validation.
Replay exact case groups in source order rather than adapting already-collapsed list diagnostics.
Preserve typed case representatives through output dtype inference and reproduce schema, index, attrs, and token counters.
Compare native outputs against every captured case and extend the evidence with non-fitting nets and custom selectors.
limits: This is a public evidence checkpoint; native dataframe diagnostics output remains unimplemented.
Flower-net cases do not establish non-fitting diagnostics or arbitrary public parameters.
